# Fixture attribution

Each `<dataset>.json` holds the canonical frames (questions, documents, grants, chunks, triples)
for the first 20 questions of a registered dataset plus the chunks they need, generated by
`scripts/make_fixture.py` from files whose sha256 is pinned in the dataset's registry entry
(`python/triplum/eval/datasets/`).

- `hotpotqa.json`, `musique.json`, `twowiki.json`: subsets of the evaluation artefacts released in
  `reproduce/dataset/` of https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/HippoRAG (MIT), which derive from
  HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://hotpotqa.github.io/), MuSiQue (Trivedi et
  al., 2022, CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/StonyBrookNLP/musique) and 2WikiMultiHopQA (Ho et al.,
  2020, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/Alab-NII/2wikimultihop).
